verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own docs say it provides an official Python client library for its APIs, so an official SDK exists. The evidence is a single brief mention covering one language, with no detail on SDK coverage or maintenance, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond Python, documentation of SDK depth and API coverage, versioning and maintenance evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Dialpad also provides a python client library, making it easier than ever to use the APIs in your python applications.
